The [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ghorman/Legends|Ghorman]] had a '''capital square'''.<ref name="NEC" /> In approximately [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FactFile|31|TAR 1-4|Grand Moff Tarkin}} states that the [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman Massacre]] took place shortly after [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] declared himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> [[Ghormanian]] citizens massed in the square<ref name="NEC" /> and at the planet's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> to protest a new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] tax.<ref name="NEC" /> The Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] landed his [[Warship/Legends|warship]] on top of the protestors, [[Death/Legends|killing]] hundreds<ref name="NEC" /> or thousands in what would be known as the [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman Massacre]].<ref name="Fact File 127">{{FactFile|127|REB 1-2|History of the Rebellion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The capital square on Ghorman was mentioned in the [[2005]] sourcebook ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]].<ref name="NEC" />
